object_description: polygonal workshop volume on a terraced base
design_condition: The prominent workshop volume and lower base are separated by a clear gap and placed across the slope to connect different campus levels, broaden the spatial setting, and expose nearby residential buildings.

positive.statement: The clear distribution of uses and spatial separation allow the existing main building to remain independent while giving the new building a self-confident presence.

position.rationale: Prominent polygonal workshop volume is clearly identifiable as the independent new building.

positive.statement: The clear gap between the buildings makes the campus appear wider and more open.

position.rationale: The top view clearly shows a separating gap between the polygonal volume and its surrounding base.

positive.statement: The polygonal volumetry shows astonishing precision, skilfully avoids building lines, and achieves well-proportioned building lengths.

position.rationale: Angular footprint and proportioned elongated edges are directly visible across the calibrated views.

positive.statement: The base building is cleverly placed in the topography and connects the different campus levels at the center.

position.rationale: Lower stepped geometry is distinguishable beneath the volume and provides the approximate base location.

positive.statement: Common uses at this interface generate the greatest publicity across the campus.

position.rationale: The interface is anchored to the visible central separation between the stepped base and workshop volume.

positive.statement: The informal gaming opportunities are well located.

position.rationale: An approximate open ground-level zone is assigned beside the polygonal building footprint.

positive.statement: The urban-planning concept and sophisticated distribution of uses create a system of high local architectural quality.

position.rationale: The distributed marker represents the visible building-base relationship across the sampled site form.

negative.statement: The formal design of the terrace appears arbitrary, without context, and does not achieve the qualities of its references.

position.rationale: The lower stepped perimeter provides the nearest visible approximation of the terrace.

negative.statement: The tree and design concept appears weak and random, and the poor ratio between hard and green spaces is hardly conducive to biodiversity.

position.rationale: Vegetation is not distinguishable, so the marker estimates an adjacent ground-level landscape area.

negative.statement: The workshop layout calls efficient organization into question, significantly undercuts the required spatial program, and creates difficult lighting conditions in some zones.

position.rationale: Interior organization is absent, anchored approximately within the visible workshop volume.

negative.statement: The inner support structure appears inflexible and sometimes obstructive at the edges.

position.rationale: The internal structure is not visible, so its location is constrained near the volume edge.

negative.statement: The effectiveness of the massive facade as active sun protection is highly questionable.

position.rationale: The outer polygonal perimeter supplies an approximate facade anchor; sun-protection performance is not visually identifiable.

negative.statement: The monumentality and gravity of the expression do not indicate the technical and didactic content of the institution.

position.rationale: The prominent elongated polygonal mass is directly visible and anchors the overall architectural expression.

negative.statement: The programmatic omissions require space-intensive adjustments in delivery and building services.

position.rationale: Service functions are not visible; the marker approximates the lower base area where adjustments would occur.

negative.statement: The escape routes would require additional access cores.

position.rationale: Escape cores are absent, estimated along the building perimeter as potential access locations.
